title: The Shepherd with the Two Staves and the Thirty Pieces of Silver
description: A prophetic action in which the Lord commands Zechariah to tend the sheep marked for slaughter. The prophet takes two staves named "Favor" and "Union," removes three shepherds in one month, and breaks the first staff to annul the covenant with the peoples. He receives thirty pieces of silver as wages and throws them into the house of the Lord to the potter. Then the second staff is broken to sever the brotherhood between Judah and Israel. The story ends with a woe pronounced over the worthless shepherd who abandons the flock.
